instances.spoken_text: A service business charges fifty-five dollars per unit with unit variable cost of twenty-five dollars. Price falls twenty-five percent. By what percentage must annual unit sales grow to keep operating profit unchanged?

follow_up.question: Could the required unit-volume increase be impossible to deliver?
follow_up.reference: Yes, capacity, customer demand or distribution reach may cap achievable volume. The calculation identifies the growth needed to preserve profit, rather than proving that the business can achieve it.
